kawaguchiko.name_zh: 富士之宿溫泉旅館 大池飯店
kawaguchiko.name_ja: 富士山の見える温泉旅館 大池ホテル
kawaguchiko.note: Do not store booking reference, PIN, payment card, or other sensitive reservation credentials in the repository.

strategy.travel_style: slow family resort trip; avoid shopping-heavy city days; keep Fuji-area driving local only
strategy.night_1_2: Tokyo central/east: Tsukiji / Higashi-Ginza / Shiodome side, two nights
strategy.night_3: 富士之宿溫泉旅館 大池飯店 (Oike Hotel), Kawaguchiko, booked for 2026-10-16
strategy.night_4: Asakusa / Oshiage for Edo atmosphere, yakitori dinner, and easy Narita departure
strategy.route: Haneda -> Tokyo two nights -> Kawaguchiko/Oshino Hakkai one night at Oike Hotel -> Asakusa/Skytree -> Narita
strategy.priority: Family vacation feeling, Mt. Fuji scenery, low hotel-change burden, minimal city shopping
strategy.car_policy: Recommended: public transit from Tokyo to Kawaguchiko, then rent locally for roughly 24 hours from 10/16 late morning to 10/17 late morning. Do not drive in Tokyo.
strategy.tsukiji_policy: Use Day 2 morning for Tsukiji; do not rely on Sunday 10/18 for the full Tsukiji experience.
strategy.hakone_policy: Hakone removed from this trip. Do not route through Odawara or Gotemba unless later needed for another confirmed stop.

proposals.title: 松山 -> 羽田 13:10 -> 東京慢慢開始
items: CI220 松山 09:00 出發，羽田 T3 13:10 抵達
入境、領行李後搭大眾運輸進東京，不租車；預期約 15:00-16:00 到飯店
入住築地／東銀座／汐留一帶，先休息
傍晚只安排低強度散步：東銀座、銀座街景或濱離宮周邊擇一
銀座只作城市散步與晚餐，不排百貨巡禮或長時間購物
第一晚晚餐保持彈性
proposals.planning_note: 抵達日不塞築地與遠距離景點，維持家人度假節奏。

proposals.title: 築地早餐 -> 東京慢遊日
items: 約 09:00 到築地場外市場，安排早餐／早午餐與市場散步
之後可接濱離宮或東銀座，避免跨城趕場
下午保留咖啡、休息、散步時間；銀座只挑真正有興趣的一兩個點
晚餐自由安排，不另外加入高密度購物行程
若 Day 4 住宿確定在淺草／押上，可考慮把大型行李提前寄往 Day 4 飯店；10/16 河口湖只帶一晚小行李
proposals.planning_note: 這天作為完整東京日，節奏比原本築地後趕箱根輕鬆很多。

proposals.title: 東京 -> 河口湖：富士山度假日
proposals.overnight: 富士之宿溫泉旅館 大池飯店 (Oike Hotel)
items: 約 08:00 前後從新宿搭預約制高速巴士前往河口湖，官方標示正常車程約 1 小時 45 分；實際班次於開放預約後再鎖定
約 10:00 前後抵達河口湖站，步行約 7 分鐘到 Toyota Rent a Car 富士河口湖店取車；建議預約 10:30 左右取車
10:45-12:15 先到忍野八海；若富士山完全露出，優先拍富士山與聚落景觀，不延伸去山中湖
12:15-13:15 在忍野／河口湖方向吃簡單午餐，避免排長隊名店
13:30-15:00 前往大石公園與河口湖北岸，散步、看湖景與富士山；10 月中旬正值園區秋季景觀期
下午入住後不再排外出景點：使用飯店 5 樓富士山展望大浴場、庭園露天風呂，休息為主
晚餐依實際訂房方案決定在飯店用餐或附近簡單吃；不另外安排夜間觀光
proposals.planning_note: 若 10/16 抵達河口湖時富士山能見度差，忍野八海和大石公園順序可以交換；能見度好的當下優先看山。

proposals.title: 河口湖慢早晨 -> 還車 -> 回東京 -> 淺草江戶散策 -> 晴空塔 -> TORIYOSHI
items: 07:00-09:00 不安排固定遠程景點；起床先看富士山。天氣好可直接從飯店的富士山展望大浴場／公共空間看山，維持度假節奏
早餐後整理行李，10:00 前退房；飯店官方有免費停車
若早晨富士山狀態特別好，可退房前後在河口湖湖畔短停 20-30 分鐘，但不再跑忍野八海或遠端景點
約 10:15-10:30 回 Toyota Rent a Car 富士河口湖店還車，步行回河口湖站
目標搭 11:00-11:30 左右的預約制高速巴士回新宿；官方標示正常車程約 1 小時 45 分，週六須預留塞車彈性
約 13:30-14:30 回到東京後前往淺草／押上住宿，取回大型行李並休息
下午做淺草江戶／下町散策：雷門、仲見世、淺草寺、巷弄與茶店，不追求全部走完
傍晚晴空塔視家人體力決定；若河口湖回程塞車或家人累，直接刪除晴空塔也沒問題
晚餐優先選浅草 TORIYOSHI，維持休閒燒鳥／雞料理路線；訂位前再確認無牛需求
proposals.planning_note: Day 4 的優先級是『河口湖慢早晨 > 回東京不趕 > 淺草 > TORIYOSHI > 晴空塔』。

proposals.title: 淺草／押上慢早晨 -> 成田 T2 -> 桃園
items: 睡晚一點，安排淺草／隅田川附近早餐與短散步
若 Day 4 因回東京較晚沒完整逛淺草，可把部分淺草行程補到上午
中午至下午保留自由時間與休息，不再硬塞遠距離景點
約 16:00-16:30 從淺草／押上方向前往成田機場 T2
CI109 成田 T2 20:00 起飛，桃園 T2 22:45 抵達
proposals.planning_note: 10/18 是星期日，不把築地作為最後一天的主要行程。

fuji_segment_detail.recommendation: Use a local 24-hour rental car only in the Fuji area.

tokyo_to_kawaguchiko.preferred: Reserved highway bus from Busta Shinjuku to Kawaguchiko Station
tokyo_to_kawaguchiko.booking_note: Seats are reserved; official reservations open one month before travel. For travel after 2026-10-01, use the operator's current Fujiyama Connect booking flow and reconfirm the timetable.

rental_car.preferred_shop: Toyota Rent a Car Fujikawaguchiko Shop
rental_car.station_access: about 7 minutes on foot from Kawaguchiko Station
rental_car.reason: Simple same-area return, easy family access to Oshino Hakkai and Oishi Park, no Tokyo driving.

route_order: Oishi Park / north shore of Lake Kawaguchi
next morning Oike Hotel Fuji view / optional short lakeside stop
fuji_segment_detail.weather_rule: Mt. Fuji visibility overrides the order. If the mountain is clearly visible, stop at the best nearby viewpoint first rather than following the clock rigidly.

rental_car_option.preferred_pickup: Toyota Rent a Car Fujikawaguchiko Shop near Kawaguchiko Station
rental_car_option.preferred_return: Same shop before returning to Tokyo
why: No need to drive from Tokyo or through Hakone now that Hakone is removed
A local car makes Kawaguchiko, Oshino Hakkai and flexible Fuji-view stops easier for family travel
Same-area pickup/return avoids unnecessary one-way rental fees and city driving
Lets the group change plans quickly based on Mt. Fuji visibility
rental_car_option.public_transit_alternative: Tokyo -> Kawaguchiko by highway bus or rail, then local buses/taxis for Kawaguchiko and Oshino Hakkai if the group decides not to drive.
verify_before_booking: Japanese driving document requirements for the actual driver
highway bus timetable and reservation after booking opens

food_preferences.yakitori: Current preferred restaurant is 浅草 TORIYOSHI. User prefers a casual true yakitori / chicken-focused meal over a high-end omakase experience and wants to avoid beef. Reconfirm no beef, beef fat or beef stock before booking if strict avoidance is required.
